relations.subject: Chögyam Trungpa
relations.evidence: Following his escape from Tibet, he studied at Oxford University and acquired a prodigious English vocabulary and uncanny understanding of Western culture and mind.

relations.subject: Chögyam Trungpa
relations.evidence: He arrived in North America in 1970 and remained there until his death, teaching extensively and establishing many dharma centers and other institutions such as Naropa University and Shambhala Training.
